questions.stem: Which of the following statements are incorrect about vasopressin?

options.label: A
options.text: It's a more powerful vasoconstrictor than angiotensin II.

options.label: B
options.text: Concentration of circulating blood vasopressin after severe hemorrhage can increase enough to attenuate reductions in arterial pressure markedly.

options.label: C
options.text: Uses adenylyl cyclase-cAMP as well as phospholipase C system.

options.label: D
options.text: Secreted by paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus

questions.answerText: Secreted by paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D) Secreted by paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus.

questions.stem: A 35-year-old man visits his doctor because his wife has long complained of his snoring, but recently observed that his breathing stops for a couple of minutes at a time while he is sleeping. He undergoes polysomnography and ventilatory response testing to ascertain the extent and cause of his sleep apnea. The activity of the central chemoreceptors is stimulated by which of the following?

options.label: A
options.text: A decrease in the metabolic rate of the surrounding brain tissue

options.label: B
options.text: A decrease in the PO2 of blood flowing through the brain

options.label: C
options.text: An increase in the PCO2 of blood flowing through the brain

options.label: D
options.text: An increase in the pH of the CSF

questions.answerText: An increase in the PCO2 of blood flowing through the brain
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C) An increase in the PCO2 of blood flowing through the brain
